==================== SECTION 1: QUESTION DETAILS ====================

You are given an array [b]A[/b] of [b]n[/b] integers. You must perform exactly one swap of two adjacent elements, at positions [b]p[/b] and [b]p + 1[/b] (1-based).
A peak is an interior element that is strictly greater than both of its immediate neighbours. The first and last elements can never be peaks.
Choose the swap that produces the greatest number of peaks. If several swaps give the same number of peaks, choose the smallest [b]p.[/b] Report the chosen position [b]p,[/b] the resulting number of peaks, and the complete array after that swap.
[b]You are required to debug the following function:[/b]
[code-c]int* PeakExchangeAudit(int n, int* A, int* returnSize);[/code][code-cpp]vector&lt;int&gt; PeakExchangeAudit(int n, vector&lt;int&gt;&amp; A);[/code][code-java]static int[] PeakExchangeAudit(int n, int[] A)[/code][code-python]def PeakExchangeAudit(n, A):[/code]

The function accepts [b]n[/b] and the 0-indexed array [b]A.[/b] It must return a single array of [b]n + 2[/b] integers: the chosen position [b]p,[/b] the resulting number of peaks, and then the [b]n[/b] values of the array after the chosen swap. In C, the size of the returned array is stored in [b]returnSize.[/b]

[b]Note:[/b][ul][li]Swapping two equal values leaves the array unchanged, but it still counts as the one required swap.[/li][li]Every peak in the whole array is counted after the swap, not only peaks near the swapped positions.[/li][/ul]
[b]Input Format:[/b][ul][li]The first line contains [b]n.[/b][/li][li]The second line contains [b]n[/b] integers [b]A[1], A[2], ..., A[n].[/b][/li][/ul][b]Input will be read from the STDIN by the candidate.[/b]

[b]Output Format:[/b]
Print the chosen position [b]p[/b] on the first line, the resulting number of peaks on the second line, and the array after the swap on the third line.
[b]The output will be matched to the candidate&#39;s output printed on the STDOUT.[/b]

[b]Constraints:[/b][ul][li]2 &le; [b]n[/b] &le; 1000[/li][li]&minus;10[sup]9[/sup] &le; [b]A&#91;i&#93;[/b] &le; 10[sup]9[/sup][/li][/ul]
[b]Example:[/b]
[b]Input:[/b]
6
2 5 1 4 3 6
[b]Output:[/b]
5
2
2 5 1 4 6 3
[b]Explanation:[/b]
The five possible swaps give 1, 1, 1, 1 and 2 peaks respectively. Swapping positions 5 and 6 produces [2, 5, 1, 4, 6, 3], where 5 and 6 are peaks, so [b]p = 5[/b] with [b]2[/b] peaks.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
5
7 7 7 7 7
[b]Sample Output[/b]
1
0
7 7 7 7 7


==================== SECTION 2: CODE TEMPLATE ====================

----- Language: C -----

Prefix:
int* PeakExchangeAudit(int n, int* A, int* returnSize);

int main()
{
    //Input read from STDIN
    int *p = PeakExchangeAudit(n, A, &returnSize);
    //Value in p is printed to STDOUT
    return 0;
}

Suffix:
int* PeakExchangeAudit(int n, int* A, int* returnSize)
{
/* Write your code here. */
    int bestPos = 1, bestPeaks = -1;
    for (int p = 0; p < n - 1; p++)
    {
        int t = A[p];
        A[p] = A[p + 1];
        A[p + 1] = t;
        int peaks = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n - 2; i++)
        {
            if (A[i] > A[i - 1] && A[i] >= A[i + 1])
                peaks++;
        }
        if (peaks > bestPeaks)
        {
            bestPeaks = peaks;
            bestPos = p + 1;
        }
        t = A[p];
        A[p] = A[p + 1];
        A[p + 1] = t;
    }
    int* result = (int*)malloc((n + 2) * sizeof(int));
    result[0] = bestPos;
    result[1] = bestPeaks;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        result[i + 2] = A[i];
    int t = result[bestPos + 1];
    result[bestPos + 1] = result[bestPos + 2];
    result[bestPos + 2] = t;
    *returnSize = n + 2;
    return result;
}

Suffix:
vector<int> PeakExchangeAudit(int n, vector<int>& A)
{
/* Write your code here. */
    int bestPos = 1, bestPeaks = -1;
    for (int p = 0; p < n - 1; p++)
    {
        swap(A[p], A[p + 1]);
        int peaks = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n - 2; i++)
        {
            if (A[i] > A[i - 1] && A[i] >= A[i + 1])
                peaks++;
        }
        if (peaks > bestPeaks)
        {
            bestPeaks = peaks;
            bestPos = p + 1;
        }
        swap(A[p], A[p + 1]);
    }
    vector<int> result;
    result.push_back(bestPos);
    result.push_back(bestPeaks);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        result.push_back(A[i]);
    swap(result[bestPos + 1], result[bestPos + 2]);
    return result;
}

Suffix:
static int[] PeakExchangeAudit(int n, int[] A) {
    /* Write your code here. */
    int bestPos = 1, bestPeaks = -1;
    for (int p = 0; p < n - 1; p++) {
        int t = A[p];
        A[p] = A[p + 1];
        A[p + 1] = t;
        int peaks = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n - 2; i++) {
            if (A[i] > A[i - 1] && A[i] >= A[i + 1])
                peaks++;
        }
        if (peaks > bestPeaks) {
            bestPeaks = peaks;
            bestPos = p + 1;
        }
        t = A[p];
        A[p] = A[p + 1];
        A[p + 1] = t;
    }
    int[] result = new int[n + 2];
    result[0] = bestPos;
    result[1] = bestPeaks;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        result[i + 2] = A[i];
    int t = result[bestPos + 1];
    result[bestPos + 1] = result[bestPos + 2];
    result[bestPos + 2] = t;
    return result;
}

----- Language: Python -----

Prefix:
# Input read from STDIN
p = PeakExchangeAudit(n, A)
# Values at p are printed to STDOUT

Suffix:
def PeakExchangeAudit(n, A):
    # Write your code here.
    best_pos = 1
    best_peaks = -1
    for p in range(n - 1):
        A[p], A[p + 1] = A[p + 1], A[p]
        peaks = 0
        for i in range(1, n - 2):
            if A[i] > A[i - 1] and A[i] >= A[i + 1]:
                peaks += 1
        if peaks > best_peaks:
            best_peaks = peaks
            best_pos = p + 1
        A[p], A[p + 1] = A[p + 1], A[p]
    result = [best_pos, best_peaks] + A
    result[best_pos + 1], result[best_pos + 2] = result[best_pos + 2], result[best_pos + 1]
    return result

        int[] A = new int[n];
        for(int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            A[i] = scan.nextInt();
        CojUserHelperFunctions.__DEBUG_START(127);
        int[] p = PeakExchangeAudit(n, A);
        CojUserHelperFunctions.__DEBUG_END(127);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append(p[0]).append("\n").append(p[1]).append("\n");
        for(int i = 2; i < p.length; i++)
        {
            if(i > 2)
                sb.append(' ');
            sb.append(p[i]);
